data: Which PoS are considered in the study?

The caption states that the study considers the average models (BERT 13, ELMo 3) on incoming dependencies of different part-of-speech categories. The x-axis of the bar chart represents the UAS values for various part-of-speech categories. The y-axis lists the part-of-speech categories, which include X, VERB, SYM, SCONJ, PUNCT, PROPN, PRON, PART, NUM, NOUN, INTJ, DET, CCONJ, AUX, ADV, ADP, and ADJ. Therefore, the part-of-speech categories considered in the study are X, VERB, SYM, SCONJ, PUNCT, PROPN, PRON, PART, NUM, NOUN, INTJ, DET, CCONJ, AUX, ADV, ADP, and ADJ.
